newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold exchange prices firm, volume weak.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold exchange prices firm, volume weak.

text.p: Prices firmed slightly but trade was quiet on the Istanbul gold exchange on Wednesday as demand weakened with the passing of the weekly delivery deadline to the state mint, dealers said.
Gold closed at $370.00 an ounce, up from $369.40 on Tuesday, and at 1,238,000 lira per gramme, versus 1,237,500.
Volume dived to 130 kg after 740 kg on Tuesday and 922 kg on Monday.

Dealers said physical demand shrank after the Wednesday deadline for submission to the government mint for the coining of gold bullion. Sellers were also reluctant as the lira firmed against the dollar.
The Turkish lira closed at 103,900 to the dollar versus Tuesday's 104,050.
The morning session saw 70 kg of trade and the afternoon 60 kg. 61.5 percent of trade was conducted in lira terms.
